1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not comprise sodium hydroxide or other alkaline solutions__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and does not comprise sodium hydroxide or other alkaline solutions__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __in the absence of enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __in the absence of enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __in the absence of enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __in the absence of enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __selected from proteases or other enzymes that do not degrade plant cell walls__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME __or other non-cell-wall-degrading enzymes__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __by methods other than direct use of soaking solution without further processing__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and performing magnetic separation__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __that have not undergone maturation drying__.

12. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed on DNA extracted from shed cellular material rather than on DNA from disrupted embryo tissue__.

14. (Previously presented) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __to correlate genotype with phenotype__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __on the extracted DNA__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __without destroying the embryo during the sampling process__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __that were previously sampled non-destructively__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __including automated non-destructive sampling and genotyping__.
